body.purpose: Everything read: labels, sentences, headings on cards. 16px, line height 1.55.

figures.purpose: Durations, money, times and counts a person compares down a column. Always tabular-nums.

wordmark.purpose: The paratrack name in the header. Inter 750, tight tracking, nothing else.

shadows.name: float-md
shadows.purpose: Date calendar and toasts. Floating layers only, never a resting card.

shadows.name: float-lg
shadows.purpose: Confirmation dialog, above a 50% black scrim.

shadows.name: fab
shadows.purpose: Phone timer button, the one shadow a thumb reaches for.

motion.name: ease-emphasized
motion.purpose: The single timing function for every transition and entrance.

motion.name: motion-quick
motion.purpose: Small state changes: hover, press, tooltip.

motion.name: motion-base
motion.purpose: A panel arriving or leaving: dropdown, sheet, toast.

motion.name: motion-thorough
motion.purpose: A container moving: the sidebar opening and closing.

breakpoints.name: phone-max
breakpoints.purpose: Below this: bottom tab bar, sheet navigation, 48dp touch floor.

breakpoints.name: data-fold
breakpoints.purpose: Below this height the Данные group folds unless the person is inside it.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one charcoal action on a form. Default size, 36px tall.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 36px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: 10px; background: oklch(0.205 0 0); color: oklch(0.985 0 0); font: 500 14px/1 Inter, sans-serif; border: 0; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.205 0 0 / 0.8); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(0.55 0.16 284 / 0.5); outline-offset: 0; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action beside the primary one, on paper.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 36px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.922 0 0); background: oklch(0.99 0.008 85); color: oklch(0.17 0.008 75); font: 500 14px/1 Inter, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: oklch(0.945 0.013 85); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(0.55 0.16 284 / 0.5); outline-offset: 0; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Row actions inside a list: Только эта, Пауза, Стоп. Stop takes the destructive ink.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 28px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: 8px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.17 0.008 75); font: 500 14px/1 Inter, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: oklch(0.945 0.013 85); } .ds-btn-stop { color: oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325); } .ds-btn-stop:hover { background: oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325 / 0.1); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(0.55 0.16 284 / 0.5); outline-offset: 0; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: The one field a person types into. 36px tall, 16px text on a phone so iOS does not zoom.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 36px; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.62 0 0); background: transparent; color: oklch(0.17 0.008 75); font: 16px/1.5 Inter, sans-serif; outline: none; } @media (min-width: 768px) { .ds-input { font-size: 14px; } } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.49 0.01 75); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: oklch(0.55 0.16 284); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.55 0.16 284 / 0.5); }

components.name: Ledger Card
components.description: A sheet on the paper, separated by a ring, never a heavy border. Title and body share one alignment.
components.html:
Идут сейчас

Таймер появится здесь.
components.css: .ds-card { display: grid; gap: 16px; padding: 16px; border-radius: 14px; background: oklch(0.99 0.008 85); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.1); } .ds-card-title { margin: 0; font: 600 14px/1.3 Inter, sans-serif; color: oklch(0.17 0.008 75); } .ds-card-body { margin: 0; font: 14px/1.55 Inter, sans-serif; color: oklch(0.49 0.01 75); }

components.name: Running Timer Row
components.description: One live activity in the Идут сейчас list. The 3px spine carries the activity colour; the clock is a tabular figure.
components.css: .ds-timer-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 12px 0; border-top: 1px solid oklch(0.922 0 0 / 0.7); } .ds-timer-row:first-child { border-top: 0; } .ds-spine { width: 3px; height: 20px; border-radius: 999px; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-clock { font: 13px/1.2 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: oklch(0.49 0.01 75); }

narrative.overview: paratrack is a ledger of where time goes. The page is a warm sheet of paper with ink on it. Figures stand in columns, rules separate rows, and the only colour belongs to the person's own activities. Running work is a short list of live lines, each with its own spine and its own stop. Nothing decorates; the numbers have to be trusted, so they are set plainly.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper ground in light, neutral in dark, with a hue of 85 at low chroma
Figures in JetBrains Mono with tabular numerals, always in columns
One colour per activity, shown as a 3px spine beside the name
Flat at rest; shadows only on floating layers
One easing curve and three durations for all motion

rules.name: The Ledger Paper Rule
rules.body: The page is a warm sheet, never pure white. The warmth is a low-chroma hue of 85, and the activity colours stay the only chroma on a screen.

rules.name: The Spine Rule
rules.body: An activity's colour is a 3px spine beside its name. It is never the ink of a label.

rules.name: The Figures Rule
rules.body: Every figure a person compares down a column is JetBrains Mono with tabular numerals.

rules.name: The Resting Flat Rule
rules.body: Cards and rows are flat at rest. A shadow appears only on a layer that floats above the page.

dos: Do set running timers as a list of live lines, each with its own pause and stop.
Do keep 48dp touch targets for every control a phone user presses.
Do name the action on a button and what it will do.
donts: Don't use gradients, glass, or decorative blur in the app.
Don't colour a label with an activity colour.
Don't let a timer row carry a shadow at rest.
